reasons: Claimed status is compliant and, consistent with that, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed — the rendered paragraphs are identical to the originals and no deterministic checks failed.

The cited text supports the conclusion: deposits into the Acquisition Account are made by the Class A Certificateholder 'solely at its option' (p0223), transfers of Additional Receivables are conditional (p0037), and payment is limited to the Additional Receivables Cash Transfer Amount actually on deposit and only 'in consideration for the acquisition of Additional Receivables' (p0224) — i.e., consideration for assets actually acquired, with no committed volume, take-or-pay or usage cap on our side.

No shortfall penalty runs against our party; the definitions (Additional Receivables Cash Transfer Amount as the lesser of the transfer amount and amounts on deposit) corroborate that there is no obligation to fund a minimum.
Correctly characterised as meeting the preferred position rather than raised as a negotiation issue; retaining it as internal evaluation evidence is appropriate and there is no over-flagging.
